conclusions.architecture: The official path is coherent at the launcher/runtime boundary but overloaded by optional rollout/audit commands and surrounded by large historical platform and stage-wrapper families.
conclusions.size: The near-600 MB workspace is overwhelmingly caused by ignored NTPE.zip (587,775,785 bytes), not source or ordinary artifact growth.
conclusions.quality: Naturalness, completeness, unsupported-detail, Hangul, repetition, glossary, character memory, discipline, and quality-v5 checks are wired into the active TXT runtime. Stage 11 is offline governance; Stage 12.1 is disconnected.
conclusions.stage11: Consolidate into quality/assessment, quality/review, and quality/corpus with frozen compatibility wrappers.
conclusions.stage12: Stage 12 A/B expansion should stop. Three execution rounds did not produce a complete reviewable pair or verified quality improvement.
conclusions.deletion: Start only with rebuildable packages/caches after archive and reference verification; legacy code deletion requires a separate dynamic-import and external-consumer audit.

stage11.facade_assessment: translation_quality_framework_integration is not behaviorless: it resolves, hashes, orders, and validates cross-stage references. Retain initially as a thin compatibility facade; move mechanics to shared evidence/integrity utilities.
stage11.planner_assessment: Improvement Planner is offline human-governed planning, not a production runtime module. Fold into quality/review/planning.
stage11.provenance_assessment: Human Decision and Corpus Governance should share actor/time/artifact provenance value objects while retaining different lifecycle schemas.
compatibility_wrappers: all seven named Stage 11 package imports plus translation_quality_corpus during migration

stage12.reason: No complete reviewable baseline/candidate pair and no human quality decision.
stage12.product_vs_experiment: The candidate is an experiment, not a product feature. Keep it disabled and move it to experiments after preserving compatibility evidence.
stage12.retention: Archive execution packages, raw/timeout metadata, manifests, and review templates externally with SHA-256. Do not keep expanding stage wrappers in active source.
stage12.test_action: Merge five Stage 12 root/integration pairs into one parameterized package/integrity suite plus a compatibility wrapper.

highest_risks.item: Consolidating Provider authorization/redaction boundaries can accidentally broaden execution or leak prompt/credential data.
Merging runtime, production_runtime, and LTS paths can break retry, timeout, resume, or output assembly.
Shared path/reference helpers can weaken root containment or artifact integrity if semantics are normalized incorrectly.
Stage 11 hash/schema consolidation can invalidate frozen artifacts and public imports.
Deleting legacy quality/context modules without dynamic-import and external-consumer evidence can remove latent user workflows.
